data.professional_title: Senior BA | Payment Consultant | Product Owner
data.summary: Senior Business Analyst with over 9.3 years of experience in the Core Banking and Payments domain, currently contributing to mission-critical solutions at Tech Mahindra, with deep engagement in Temenos Payments Hub (TPH), SEPA, SWIFT, ISO 15022 and ISO 20022. Possesses a strong understanding of payment orchestration systems and interbank communication flows, enabling delivery of scalable and compliant financial services infrastructure across global banking clients. Competent at aligning testing strategies with product and regulatory requirements, with a focus on optimizing functional and non-functional testing coverage in complex banking ecosystems. Skilled to work seamlessly across Agile, Scrum, and SAFe frameworks, enhancing cross-functional collaboration and accelerating sprint-level deliveries with high precision. Known for bridging technical implementation with business impact, ensuring that system behavior adheres to both performance metrics and regulatory expectations, especially within ISO 20022 migration landscapes. Proficient in collaborative stakeholder engagement, interfacing with business analysts, developers, and QA teams to streamline requirement traceability and defect resolution, reducing release cycle time.

responsibilities: Led the functional and business analysis for various product lines including cash deposit, funds transfer, Business Banking via SCPay, ATLAS for Hong Kong and Cross border transfer.
Stakeholder collaboration with cross functional teams to gather requirement and document user journey, pain points and functional specs.
Involved in multiple key banking journeys including Business Banking, Mortgages, Cash operations and WRB Payments- DDA and DDI, enhancing end to end process efficiency and customer experience.
Actively involved in requirement gathering and analysis for the WRB – DDA/DDI module, focusing on Off-Us and On-Us mandate creation and verification process using ISO message standards.
Contributed to end-to-end dry run and validation processes ensuring seamless message flow and compliance for ISO 20022 message including pain.009, pain.010, pain.011, pain.012, pacs.003 and pacs.008.
Collaborated with product teams and stakeholders to gather requirements for user journeys, and participated in dry runs to define and validate automation scope.
Involved in CASA Management, Payment validations, Report generations, Filtering and Reconciliations with the payment engine as per the stakeholder requirement.
Validated ATLAS implementation for Hong Kong ensuring accurate mapping of user requirements and system functionality for seamless integration.
Worked closely with upstream and downstream systems to validate message orchestration, data mapping and reconciliation accuracy.
Conducted requirement gathering workshops, discovery sessions, and stakeholder discussions to capture business needs and translate them into functional requirements and user stories.
Performed detailed business and functional analysis, preparing BRDs, FRDs, process flows, use cases, and requirement traceability matrices (RTM) to ensure complete requirement coverage.

Collaborated with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, and Temenos consultants to analyze requirements, identify impacts, and drive successful implementation of payment solutions.
Performed gap analysis and solution assessment to align business requirements with Temenos Payments Hub (TPH) capabilities while minimizing customization and maintaining product standards.
Supported end-to-end project delivery by participating in sprint planning, backlog grooming, UAT coordination, defect triage, and production readiness activities to ensure successful releases.
Led business analysis and testing efforts for SEPA, SWIFT, CBPR+, and Temenos Payments Hub (TPH), managing a cross-functional team and ensuring delivery of high-quality payment solutions.
Translated business requirements into detailed user stories, use cases, BRDs, and FSDs, driving alignment across development and QA teams.
Conducted grooming sessions to prioritize backlog items, performed root cause analysis, and supported through all QA phases.
Drafted and executed functional test cases for payment message formats, ensuring compliance with ISO20022 standards in the Real-Time Payments environment.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops, gathered requirements through interviews and focus groups, and executed detailed gap and impact analyses using UML and data flow diagrams.
Contributed to SEPA- CT/DD, Instant payment flows using ISO 20022 message formats such as pain.001, pain.002, pacs.008, pacs.002, pacs.004, pacs.028, camt.056, camt.029 and camt.054.
Authored and managed detailed user stories and acceptance criteria in JIRA for payments features such as SEPA Credit Transfer, SWIFT MT103 processing, and sanctions screening.
Performed techno-functional responsibilities including client-specific configurations, system integration support and in log analysis for issue recreation.
Involved in ISO 20022 migration from ISO 15022 (MT to MX) and implementation of SEPA Rule book Changes to ensure compliance with regularity standards.
Acted as SME for the client portal UI, supporting requirement gathering, test case development, and validation aligned with client specifications.
Participated in sprint meetings and reviews, identifying process gaps and driving improvements for enhanced team collaboration and product quality.
Involved in gap analysis and version control for Access portal involving TCH and FedNow clearing customers.
Conducted AML/FCM screening and profiling using Factiva–Dow Jones/OFAC tools to ensure adherence to global sanctions and PEP lists.
Used Elicitation techniques like interviewing, questionnaires, brainstorming, JAD, workshops, observation, and document analysis for requirement gathering.
Regularly participated in JIRA ceremonies and facilitated training and KT sessions for new joiners, enabling swift onboarding and understanding of product and process methodologies.
Ensured quality assurance across critical ISO 20022 messages including pacs.008, pacs.002, camt.056, pain.013, camt.026, and others for TCH and FedNow clearing.
Acted as QA and SME for the Access Portal UI, contributing to test strategy, test case development, and execution aligned with product and client requirements.
Played a key role in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demos, and retrospectives while conducting detailed regression testing and walkthroughs.
Mentored new team members by conducting structured knowledge transfer and onboarding sessions to ramp up product familiarity.
Led requirement elicitation sessions using interviews, questionnaires, document analysis, and workshops to capture clear and actionable business needs.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams through development, testing (Functional, Regression, UAT), and deployment to ensure end-to-end solution delivery.
Supported sprint planning by clarifying requirements and aiding accurate user story estimation; led backlog grooming sessions via JIRA.
Contributed to European payments initiatives (SEPA CT/DD, SWIFT) with hands-on experience in ISO 20022 message formats: pain.001/002, pacs.008/002/004, camt.056/029/054.
Involved in release migration activities and release upgrades and AMR activities.
Conducted UAT and reported results to stakeholders, ensuring quality assurance during resource constraints.

Performed end-to-end functional testing on TPH enhancements aligned with ISO 20022 standards (pain.001/002/008, pacs.008/009/002/004, camt.029/054/056) across SEPA CT, DD, INSTANT-TIPS and clearing systems like TARGET2, IBERPAY, EBAINST.
Tested legacy SWIFT (MT101, 103, 202, 202COV) and MX (pacs.008/009/002/004) for compliance and message mapping accuracy.
Reduced false positives through process optimization and enhanced AML rule tuning in collaboration with compliance teams.
Administered major rulebook-driven updates for SEPA, SWIFT, and Instant Payments mapping and validation.
Designed test plans, test cases, peer reviews, and test data setup; tracked execution and bugs in RTC.
Achieved 85% automation coverage using SEAT, Cypress, and Selenium; improved release quality and cycle time.
Delivered training, KT, and client demo sessions; addressed escalations and provided support to T24 clients.
Executed test cases and created test data to validate functionalities of the Tachy Loans digital platform as per the testing plan.
Maintained the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) to ensure comprehensive coverage of all test scenarios.
Performed cross-browser and parallel testing to verify consistent platform performance across multiple devices.
Configured Maven and implemented the Page Object Model (POM) framework for Java automation, leveraging keyword and data-driven testing with Apache POI for efficient test data management.
Involved in Mobile testing and cross OS testing.
